description: Use this when the user wants a mortgage calculator, loan calculator, or amortization calculator result: the monthly (or biweekly/weekly) payment, an amortization schedule or table, total interest, payoff date, a mortgage calculator with extra payments or for paying off early, or a full PITI payment with property tax, insurance, HOA and PMI. Takes the loan amount or home price with down payment, rate, and term. Returns exact payment, totals, interest and time saved by extra payments, a yearly summary, and a CSV of the full schedule. Fixed-rate loans only; does not model adjustable rates, interest-only or balloon loans, and does not look up current rates. Do not use for rent-vs-buy advice or choosing a lender.

accelerated.description: For biweekly/weekly only: true pays half (biweekly) or a quarter (weekly) of the monthly payment each period, which adds about one extra monthly payment a year. Default false (a true biweekly/weekly amortization).

annual_rate.description: Annual interest rate in percent (nominal APR used for the payment), e.g. 6.5 for 6.5%. 0 is allowed.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for formatting, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP. Default USD.

down_payment.description: Down payment amount, e.g. 50000. Used with home_price.

down_payment_percent.description: Down payment as a percent of home_price, e.g. 20 for 20%.

extra_payment.description: Extra principal paid with every payment, e.g. 200 for $200 more each month.

home_insurance_annual.description: Yearly homeowners insurance for the PITI breakdown, e.g. 1500.

home_price.description: Purchase price or current home value, e.g. 400000. Used with down_payment/down_payment_percent to get the loan amount, and as the value for PMI loan-to-value.

amount.description: Lump-sum amount paid toward principal, e.g. 10000.

date.description: Month (YYYY-MM) or day (YYYY-MM-DD) of the lump sum, e.g. 2029-06. It is applied with the first payment on or after that date.

payment_number.description: Alternative to date: apply the lump sum with this payment number, e.g. 60 for the 60th payment.

payment_frequency.description: How often payments are made: monthly (default), biweekly (every 2 weeks, 26 a year), or weekly (52 a year).

pmi_rate.description: Yearly private mortgage insurance rate as a percent of the original loan, e.g. 0.5. Needs home_price. Charged only while the loan is above 80% of the home value, and dropped once the balance reaches 78%.

principal.description: Loan amount to borrow, e.g. 350000. Give this OR home_price with a down payment.

property_tax_annual.description: Yearly property tax for the PITI breakdown, e.g. 4800.

start_date.description: Date of the first payment, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-11. Defaults to the first day of next month.

term_months.description: Loan term in months, e.g. 360 or 72 for a car loan.

term_years.description: Loan term in years, e.g. 30. Give term_years or term_months.

name: calculate_loan
title: Calculate loan or mortgage
